## Services available for scoped paid engagements
- Node.js / Express and Python / FastAPI API integrations and backend workflows
- AI workflow and evaluation tooling, reviewer consoles, task/rubric operations
- Reliability engineering, automated testing, state transitions, idempotency and audit trails
- Internal tools, proof-of-concept builds and technical investigations

## Selected work and evidence
- RecoverIT: AI-assisted payment recovery workflow with deterministic controls, human approval gates and 21/21 synthetic test-mode checks. https://github.com/Prakash-codeMaker/RecoverIT
- TaskOps: AI data operations console with task intake, reviewer assignment, versioned rubrics, adjudication and audit history. Public showcase uses synthetic records. https://github.com/Prakash-codeMaker/taskops-ai-quality-operations
- FleetScope: synthetic telemetry reliability lab with 30 local tests and 95.68% line coverage. https://fleetscope-telemetry-lab.vercel.app/
- GAINN: multi-agent information workflow separating research, drafting and quality control; 2,000+ reported sign-ups. https://ever-news-flow.lovable.app
- ReLoop: multi-role material coordination workspace with Node.js APIs, authorization and handover history. https://github.com/Prakash-codeMaker/reloop-environmental-hacks
- BolKeResolve: voice-first, evidence-aware support MVP; demo cases are fictional and it does not access bank accounts or move money. https://bolkeresolve.vercel.app

- Unpaid production work is not treated as a hiring assessment.
